title: eludite.update.apply input
description: Restart Eludite into the staged build: the shell asks about unsaved changes, quits (every agent session with it), the new executable swaps the install folder's files (the old ones go to `.eludite-previous/` until the next start) and starts with the same arguments. Refused when no build is staged (`ready`). From the menu or the status bar the person is asked first; an agent's call is dangerous (the policy prompts unless it allows it).
